evidence_snippets: Create a cluster by using the Google Cloud console This page shows you how to use the Google Cloud console to create a Managed Service for Apache Spark cluster, run a basic Apache Spark job in the cluster, and then modify the number of workers in the cluster.

"Managed Service for Apache Spark" is the new name for the product formerly known as "Dataproc on Compute Engine" (cluster deployment) and "Google Cloud Serverless for Apache Spark" (serverless deployment).
